50.comment: Forms input background (form.scss:10, lowercase #fafafb). Note the trailing B — one bit off #FAFAFA, a transcription/Figma float32-readback trap. Lighter than gray/100.

115.comment: table[border] variant border color (tables.scss:7,10). Sits between the existing gray.100 (#F3F3F3) and gray.150 (#E6E5E5) by lightness.

150.comment: Brand bar below-row border. 4.x: hardcoded #e6e5e5 in brand-bar.scss

155.comment: Browser-rounded form of 4.x $lighter-gray = color.scale($blk, lightness: 90%), shared by Accordion and Pager.

160.comment: Forms disabled input background (form.scss:11, lowercase #e1e1e1). Between gray/150 and gray/175.

165.comment: table--gray-borders light border color (tables.scss sticky and cell borders). Between gray.160 and gray.175 by lightness.

175.comment: Brand footer muted text. 4.x: hardcoded #ccc. Near-duplicate of gray/200 #CACACA — consolidation candidate for 5.x

310.comment: Brand footer contact icon links. 4.x: hardcoded #999. Near-duplicate of gray/300 #9A9A9A — consolidation candidate for 5.x

350.comment: Forms text-input focus outline color (form.scss:50, lowercase #8a8a8a). Same value is separately baked into the select-arrow SVG data-URI as rgb(138,138,138) (form.scss:199) — an un-bindable duplicate, not unified by this token.

365.comment: table--gray-borders dark border color for thead rows and sticky compensation (tables.scss).

450.comment: 4.x $med-gray = color.scale($blk, lightness: 40%), used by Tabs text and indicators.

600.comment: Brand footer socket separator. 4.x: hardcoded #5d5656 in brand-footer.scss

700.comment: Forms disabled input foreground (form.scss:12, lowercase #484741). Warm (non-neutral) cast, darker than gray/600.

750.comment: Table caption background (tables.scss:112), darker than the existing gray.700 step.

highlight.comment: Table hover-row/cell background in the hover-highlight variant (tables.scss:100,102).

danger-light.comment: 4.x: $danger-light = color.scale($danger, $lightness: 85%); Forms error input background/glow (form.scss:59,:62,:346). Sass compiles to fractional rgb(247.39, 226.01, 220.76) — this is the browser-computed rounding (verified via dart-sass); a documented re-baseline is expected if serialization differs.

black-125.comment: uids-core.scss:32 --transparent-border: rgb(0, 0, 0, .125) — default subtle border on light/ambient backgrounds; the border-foundation commit repoints --transparent-border at color.border.default. Names are alpha-per-mille (0.125 -> 125), matching the space.* rem-x-100 spirit. Literal 4.x value — flat, no brandChannel.

white-325.comment: Same value, two pre-migration spellings: _background.scss:54 rgba(255,255,255,.325) and the border mixin's bg--black override, _utilities.scss:197, hsla(0,0%,100%,.325). Literal — flat, no brandChannel.

black-425.comment: button.scss:10 rgba(0, 0, 0, .425) — button border over an ambient light background ([class*='bg--'] ancestor). button.scss swaps the literal to this primitive's var in the border-foundation commit. Literal — flat, no brandChannel.

white-425.comment: button.scss:15,50,71 rgba(255, 255, 255, .425) in three whitespace/leading-zero spellings — button border over a dark background ([class*='bg--black'] ancestor, and the secondary/transparent colorways). Swapped to this primitive's var alongside black-425. Literal — flat, no brandChannel.

gray-201-500.comment: Canonical computed form of Menu's hsla(0, 0%, 79%, .5) separator color (menu.scss:24).
